$comment: Advisories accepted after review, used by scripts/audit.mjs in the nightly run. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry date; an expired entry fails the audit again so it gets looked at.

exceptions.reason: Denial of service through unbounded precision specifiers. No fixed version exists (1.1.3 is the latest). Only reached through electron-builder's download tooling (global-agent > roarr) at build time, with no untrusted format strings; it never ships in Playlish.
